data.text:
MARCOS ANNOUNCES GOV’T AID TO MANILA FIRE VICTIMS

President Bongbong Marcos visits Delpan Sports Complex and Delpan Evacuation Center in Manila on Monday to check the welfare of families affected by the fire in Parola Compound.

“Meron po tayong hygiene kit, meron pa po tayong family cooking kit, meron pa po tayong  binibigay na food pack. At bukod pa ron ‘yung P10,000 na assistance para meron po kayong magamit,” he said.

“Nandito ang NHA meron pang-rebuilding magbibigay din ng P30,000 para pambili ninyo ng gamit,” Marcos added. (Video courtesy of MPC)
